_doc: Engine release history — the source of truth for what users can fetch. Each entry: version, date, files (name -> sha256), artifactFormat (v1 = carved minified js; v2 = sealed binary), notes. Hashes here must match shim/lib/versions.mjs for the pinned version.

releases.notes: First real engine release. Local runtime + guided init + sync/go-live cloud handshake + additive promote ceremony + feedback command. Carved: internal plane, platform billing, prod adapters absent (CARVE-BOUNDARY marker-scan green at dev repo d3bf317).

AGENT-EOF wave: init on a pipe hands off to a human (exit 0) instead of crashing; every interview prompt EOF-safe; unknown commands exit 1; project-less collections says init-first. Shim 0.1.1 alongside: Node>=18 guard + ESM cache marker (kills the reparse warning). Built from dev repo 9f82d94, gate 226+31+12 green.

Message-truth wave. 0.1.1's agent handoff named gemmein/llms.txt — a path nothing creates, in an order that couldn't work; it now points at `gemmein dev` then http://127.0.0.1:4545/llms.txt. One project gate at dispatch, so `rules` and `check` stop answering as if a project existed. SHAPE-1 learning accepts pk_local_ as well as pk_test — local dev never learned shapes at all (ledger #72, cause corrected). init requires a real owner email; a busy port says so instead of dying silently. Built from dev repo 1f743f8, gate 227+31+15 green.

W3.1 sealed files — the local runtime speaks the ref contract prod ships: upload() returns ref not url, /files/{ref}/link mints delivery, the local DevKeySigner signs sealed links with the same canned-policy bytes as CloudFront (parity law, no if(isDev) in the gate). BREAKING with sdk<0.3.0 teaching; pairs with @gemmein/sdk 0.3.0. llms.txt guide updated to the ref contract AND gains the entitlements teaching: Paid ACCESS bullet (requires/grants/union/entitlement_required/purchases.mine) + Selling THINGS rewritten to the W2.5b commercial record, optional receipts, sealed-file delivery and the digital-only scope (first llms change since 0.1.0). Built from dev repo a8c477b, verify gate green (security:static + tests + apps + package), ledger 92 affirmed 0 drift.

W4 wave into the local runtime: purchases.mine() carries delivery for downloadable products (the __product_files system collection, purchase-authorized short-lived links, wider product MIME profile, 100MB cap); the byte meter with per-person ceilings and floors; the dev file sink answers browsers from any origin and refuses oversize loudly (413) instead of truncating silently. llms.txt teaching: banded v4 pricing (five thresholds spelled out) + delivery. Pairs with @gemmein/sdk 0.4.0. Built from dev repo 4590a88, verify gate green (350 security / 31 apps / package gates / boundaries), ledger 110 entries 0 drift.
